feature.name: Graphics Format
feature.what_it_does: Style a selected SVG/icon graphic — recolor, graphics styles, outline, effects, and convert it to an editable shape.
feature.affects: the appearance of the selected graphic
feature.behavior: Style a selected SVG/icon graphic — recolor, graphics styles, outline, effects, and convert it to an editable shape.

connections.why: measured: the hosting contextual tab appears only in this object's context

subfeatures.name: Graphics Outline
subfeatures.what_it_does: Sets the graphic's outline color/weight/dashes (options in the picker).

subfeatures.name: Change Graphic
subfeatures.what_it_does: Replaces the SVG/icon graphic with another from the library.

subfeatures.name: Graphics Fill (recolor)
subfeatures.what_it_does: Recolors the graphic's fill from the color picker.
subfeatures.behavior: Opens the Graphics Fill dropdown — the surface that presents this capability's options (5 controls enumerated in the structural pass). Applying a choice there changes: the graphic's fill color.

subfeatures.name: Convert to Shape
subfeatures.what_it_does: Converts the SVG graphic into an editable Word shape (or group of shapes).

subfeatures.name: Graphics Effects
subfeatures.what_it_does: Applies shadow/reflection/glow/3D effects to the graphic (menu).

subfeatures.name: Format Graphic pane
subfeatures.what_it_does: Opens the Format Graphic pane — the full fill/line/effects surface.

subfeatures.name: Graphics Styles gallery
subfeatures.what_it_does: Applies a preset fill/outline style to the graphic from the gallery.
